title: Carew Tidal Mill
scope: The standing Carew Tidal Mill, its connected north wing, and the mapped stone-faced tidal barrier with central floodgates and north spillway.
limitations: The photographs establish the pond elevation and barrier appearance. The opposite elevation, exact stone courses, gate fittings and unpublished section heights are approximate.
Terrain is unchanged. Water levels and the operation of the floodgates and milling mechanisms are outside the model scope.
